edge_case_notes: BBC World Service Africa coverage published under BBC banner. URL distinguishes Africa coverage via the slug `world-africa-NNN`. Publisher (BBC) is UK-headquartered; editorial control sits in London.
verdict_rule: Detect via DocumentIdentifier containing `bbc.com/news/world-africa` or `bbc.com/news/africa`. Roll up to International in headline analysis (publisher-origin rule). Sensitivity check in 03_robustness folds it as African.

edge_case_notes: AJE Africa coverage produced from Doha + Nairobi/Johannesburg bureaus. AJE is Qatari-owned; publisher origin = International. URL paths do not separate AJE Africa from AJE main (articles indexed by date, not region), so URL-path detection is unreliable.
verdict_rule: All aljazeera.com → International (publisher-origin rule). URL paths inspected; no reliable Africa-only path token found.

edge_case_notes: Reuters Africa correspondents but editorial control is London/NY. Wire service. URL paths inspected (`reuters.com/business/...`, `reuters.com/markets/...`, `reuters.com/article/...`); region not encoded in URL, so URL-path detection is unreliable.
French public radio's Africa service. URL reliably encodes the Africa service: `rfi.fr/fr/afrique` (French) and `rfi.fr/en/africa` (English). Publisher (France Médias Monde) is French-headquartered.
verdict_rule: Detect via DocumentIdentifier containing `rfi.fr/fr/afrique` or `rfi.fr/en/africa`. Roll up to International in headline analysis. Sensitivity check folds it as African.
